payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_finish.py::test_a_spec_text_outside_the_spec_directory_or_off_its_hash_is_refused_before_any_commit stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/finish.py. The claim was "`commit_finish` raises `ValueError` when a text it would write has a `path` that is not a `.md` file directly in `.saffron/specs/`, or a `text` whose SHA-256 is not its row's `spec_sha`. It raises before it calls `add_worktree` or writes any object. The witness drives four such paths, one through `..`, one in `done/`, one at the repository root and one ending in `.txt`, and one text off its hash. It drives each on a layer's row and, separately, on an unrun task's row.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
